description: ol-var-not-visible (issue #825) is NOT suppressed by a misplaced `global`. A `global` written inside a procedure body declares nothing and raises `ol-global-outside-root` (spec/execution-model.md:561-563), and this rule normally answers that one mistake with one diagnostic — it suppresses the `ol-undefined-var` a read of the same name would otherwise earn. **That suppression must stop at the generic code.** Here the root scope really does bind `count`, so the read is boundary-hidden, and the learner who put `global` in the wrong place is exactly the learner who needs the message that names the top-level fix. Both diagnostics are therefore reported. The paired control is check/global-outside-root-suppresses-undefined-var-style coverage in packages/parser/src/global-variables.test.mjs, where the root binds nothing and only `ol-global-outside-root` is reported.
